extrā-clūdo , ĕre, v. a.,
I.to exclude, as syn. of excludo, Beda, 2334 P.—Hence, extra-clūsus , a, um, P. a. cludo, claudo, shut out, excluded (late Lat.): agger, locus, Front. ap. Goes. p. 39; Aggen. ib. p. 60: “regio,” Hyg. ib. p. 189 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
